# HasData Documentation

- [Introduction](https://docs.hasdata.com/introduction.md): HasData extracts data quickly and reliably from any source.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.hasdata.com/quickstart.md): Start scraping data in under 5 minutes

- [API Status Codes](https://docs.hasdata.com/api-codes.md)
- [CLI](https://docs.hasdata.com/cli.md): Single-binary CLI for the HasData APIs — wired for shell scripts, LLM agents, and RAG pipelines.
- [MCP Server](https://docs.hasdata.com/mcp-server.md): Connect LLM clients and AI agents to HasData via the Model Context Protocol.
- [OpenClaw Skill](https://docs.hasdata.com/openclaw.md): Drop the HasData skill into OpenClaw for real-time web data via the hasdata CLI.
- [Agent Skills](https://docs.hasdata.com/agent-skill.md): Ready-made skills that teach AI coding agents how to use HasData.
